sources.title: Göbekli Tepe Stone Pillars
sources.author: Pre-Pottery Neolithic Builders
sources.excerpt: Massive stone pillars carved with animals: serpents, foxes, boars, cranes, vultures.
sources.longExcerpt: Before agriculture, before cities, before writing, our ancestors built Göbekli Tepe. Massive T-shaped pillars, some five meters tall, arranged in circles. Carved upon them: serpents writhing, foxes prowling, wild boars charging, cranes dancing, vultures with outstretched wings. This was no settlement but a sanctuary. Hunter-gatherers came from far and wide for feasts and rituals. They buried the site deliberately, preserving it for us to find eleven thousand years later.
